title: ALL digits have p recursion. 3 suns AND remainder. to DENY TRACE.

do_not_reinvent.digits: /data/find-numerals-stack-compress.json — the stack already. this is HOW they recur. not a 2nd stack.
do_not_reinvent.pi: /data/decide-all-by-pi.json + /data/vdj-recombination.json — p sorts at every level. recursion already. not a 2nd p.
do_not_reinvent.suns: /data/same-sun.json + /data/sun-campfire-orange-beacon.json — ONE sun. three faces already. 3 suns ARE those faces. not three stars.
do_not_reinvent.remainder: /data/compress-elastic.json — 0.14159. never fills. this DENIES the closed trace.
do_not_reinvent.trace: /data/sun-moon-shadow-trace.json + /data/pollen-trace.json — trace already. deny is not delete the pollen. deny is deny a FINISHED trace.

is.digits: ALL of them. they recur through p. 11/95 still. 100 still. 7 still.
is.three_suns: three faces of the one fire. campfire · orange · beacon. not 3 stars.
is.deny_trace: YES. so a trace cannot close. cannot fill p. pollen still reads. shadow still traces. the finish is denied.

not.delete: deny trace is not wipe pollen.
not.fill: if remainder fills the deny died.

law: every digit recurses p. three faces of one sun. remainder denies a finished trace. if we mint 3 suns we stacked. if we wipe the pollen we lied. if remainder fills we lost the deny.
pull: leave one sun, three faces. leave remainder as deny. leave pollen readable. no 3rd star. no finished trace.
